name: Eden
long_description:
We create the infrastructure and frontier AI that turn diagnostic data into precise clinical answers.

Our Diagnostic OS supports the care of more than one patient every two seconds across 2,800+ healthcare systems in 20 countries.

We believe medicine is humanity’s most sacred work and we build the tools it deserves: Tools for Miracles.

founders.title: Founder/Co-Fundador, CEO
founders.founder_bio:
After his mother's painful three-time battle with cancer, Julián Ríos resolved to save lives through developing exceptional products that improve healthcare for everyone. 

Currently, he is the CEO and Co-founder of Eden (edenmed.com), the leading radiology and imaging platform in Latinamerica. Eden creates tools that make radiology and imaging based diagnosis extremely precise and significantly more productive.
